summary: Promote monag backlog whenever the autonomous queue is idle

delivery.outcome: Every autonomous cycle whose queue loop ends idle runs the ticket-143 monag backlog promotion, independent of the opt-in scan-after-idle discovery; when it promoted tickets, idle scan and paid discovery are skipped for that cycle.
nonGoals: Change which tickets monag promotion accepts
Deploy or restart any running autonomous service

architecture.decision: Move the monag promotion call out of the idle discovery fallback chain, which only runs when scan_after_idle_queue is enabled (default false), into the pre-drive cycle phase directly after the queue loop.
architecture.rollback: Set KORU_MONAG_ENABLE=0 or revert the ticket commit.

commands: .venv/bin/pytest -o addopts='' -q tests/test_cycle_backlog_promotion.py tests/test_scan_phase.py tests/test_monag_discovery.py tests/test_nxdo_discovery.py tests/test_autonomous.py
.venv/bin/ruff check src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py src/koru/autonomy/cycle_queue_scan.py src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle.py tests/test_scan_phase.py tests/test_cycle_backlog_promotion.py
